Why extraction results were held

Snapshot: 2026-11-01 00:28 EDT. Screening decisions and extraction validation are separate.

Five held responses from the R3 pilot

All eight pilot requests returned. Three passed the full extraction check; these five contained at least one validation problem. A single failing item held the original response. These holds do not exclude the articles.

Original five pilot holds; later R3 requests are outside this table.
StudyWhy heldItems passing partial checks
PMID 39507408
Peruvian advanced-melanoma immunotherapy cohort		A source phrase meaning the median could not be estimated was placed in a wrapper marked not_reported. The strict schema requires a not_reported wrapper to have neither raw text nor a numeric value.37 / 38
PMID 22228638
SWOG/Intergroup S0438: sorafenib + temsirolimus or tipifarnib		Four facts use normalized raw strings that do not appear literally in their own quoted source, even though the source supports the underlying values.30 / 34
PMID 34926669
Chinese multicenter pembrolizumab + temozolomide retrospective study		The chemotherapy allocation count was normalized to digits rather than retaining the written number in its own source anchor.65 / 66
PMID 27776519
PTML biomarker analyses in ipilimumab/TIL melanoma cohorts		Subgroup-specific median survival facts point to a model described for the parent cohort, and two other facts have incompatible model contrast labels.17 / 21
PMID 26307133
ECOG E2603 copy-number correlative analysis: carboplatin/paclitaxel ± sorafenib		Thirteen subgroup results were linked to models whose population IDs describe the parent analysis cohort.16 / 29

Partial checks identified 165 of 188 extracted items that can be retained unchanged; 23 remain deferred. The partial views have not been published to the main studies table. Items are recorded facts, not independent effect estimates or completed studies.

R2: why About shows 223

223 recorded quarantine entries = 79 subsequently validated + 144 still without validated extraction.

Across all 821 R2 reports, 598 already have source-checked extraction and 79 have separately validated number notation, giving 677 validated records. The remaining 144 need further extraction checks. Screening has been completed for all 821 reports.

The 79 recoveries recognize unambiguous printed number notation while preserving the original numerical values. The other 92 reports with the same first error still require checking; they have not been assumed to be formatting-only problems.

First recorded validation error per report. A report can contain additional issues.

Among the 144 unresolved extractions, screening retained 130 reports for full-text review, left 10 uncertain and excluded 4. A retained report can have unvalidated extraction; its screening decision is tracked separately. One retained report is also held for a retraction.
